title: Tensorgami: complete public corpus snapshot
author: Henry Shin
scope: Entire version-121 public website and available editable public source, including public historical editions, formalizations, programs, images, research records and authoritative links.
changes: Preserves the current version-121 website, including Quotients, Refinement, and Reconstruction; Six Elements, One Comparison and its PDF and source archive; the public notes on proofs, dependencies, and revisions; the current essay PDFs and manuscripts; and all six Lean projects with their published archives. The stable Quotients exposition is preserved without modification.
source_adaptations: See archive/source-adaptations.json. Published site files are unchanged; the source copy omits private metadata and uses portable lookup in two converter scripts.
research_papers: Externally hosted research paper bodies and third-party cited works remain linked at authoritative hosts; they are not rehosted.
timestamp_evidence: GitHub published_at and cryptographically verified release attestation record this edition disclosure. Manuscript and ordinary Git dates are distinct.
rights: Existing rights notices preserved; all rights reserved unless individual files state otherwise.
limits: Preservation and exact-file correspondence, not certification of correctness, originality, exclusive priority, or earlier public availability.
